description: Crypto perpetual funding on OKX's USDT perpetuals, no key: each coin's latest eight-hour rate, the window's mean and its annualized carry (short the perpetual against long spot), the last week's, and the share of positive periods.

coins.description: Coin symbols, e.g. ["BTC", "ETH", "SOL"]; default BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE.

days.description: Window, in days back from now; default 30.

series.description: Also return each coin's funding by period; default false.

name: funding_rates

outputSchema.description: rows are coins by annualized funding, in the order of columns.

title: Crypto funding rates (OKX)
